intro: Gazlowe's Ledger is a detailed record of trade goods and inventories kept by the goblin boss of Ratchet. It serves as an accounting book to cross-check cargo shipments arriving from Booty Bay against the harbor manifest.

p: Overseeing a bustling trade port like Ratchet requires meticulous accounting. Gazlowe maintains this personal ledger to track imported crates, outbound cargo, and warehouse stores. When a long-awaited shipment from Booty Bay goes unaccounted for, Gazlowe uses the book to cross-reference his projected inventory against the maritime records kept down at the docks by Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
